2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona’s protection test meets a Chargers offense debuting new pieces
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona enters Mike LaFleur’s opener shorthanded in the secondary and interior line, with Garrett Williams, Dadrion Taylor-Demerson and Isaiah Adams ruled out while rookie back Jeremiyah Love is questionable. That puts more pressure on the Cardinals to stay efficient and avoid obvious passing downs. Los Angeles brings Justin Herbert into Mike McDaniel’s offense, but rookie center Jake Slaughter is making his NFL debut, so Arizona’s pass rush has a clear pressure point. Protection, early-down efficiency and explosive-play prevention should decide the matchup.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles has the cleaner path if Herbert stays protected, while Arizona’s best chance is to disrupt the new interior protection and keep the Chargers from creating explosive gains.
